name: DeserializeOverride
signature: public delegate (bool handled, object? result) DeserializeOverride(EchoObject data, Type targetType, SerializationContext context)

docs.summary: Called during deserialization to optionally override how an EchoObject is deserialized. Return (true, result) to use the result instead of normal deserialization. Return (false, null) to proceed with normal deserialization.
